PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1 ?var1Label
WHERE
  { wde:Q62  wdt:P47     ?var1 .
    ?var1    rdfs:label  ?var1Label
  }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P2465  "358727" }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P1562  "v507435" }

PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  url:  <http://schema.org/>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2Label ?var3
WHERE
  { BIND(wdt:P735 AS ?var4)
    ?var5  ?var6            ?var4 ;
           rdf:type         wikibase:Property ;
           wdt:P1659        ?var1 .
    ?var1  rdfs:label       ?var2Label ;
           url:description  ?var3
    FILTER ( lang(?var2Label) = "en" )
    FILTER ( lang(?var3) = "en" )
  }

PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1
WHERE
  { BIND(wde:Q2160811 AS ?var2)
    ?var2 (<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/P279>)* ?var1
  }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2Label
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P39     wde:Q842606 ;
           rdfs:label  ?var2Label
  }

PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P279  wde:Q13317 }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var2  wdt:P3430  "w6bg2mhp"
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var2  wdt:P18  ?var1 }
  }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2 ?var3 ?var4Label
WHERE
  { BIND(lang(?var5Label) AS ?var6)
    ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var4Label .
    ?var2  wdt:P1995   ?var3 ;
           rdfs:label  ?var5Label ;
           rdfs:label  ?var4Label
    FILTER ( lang(?var4Label) = "en" )
  }
